prompt:
Rewrite snippets/order-summary-rows.liquid so that it renders a cart/order summary as a definition list. Null values and empty strings must be handled differently. Inputs (all top-level; there is no section object): - `summary_title`: string or null. - `lines`: array, never null, possibly empty. Every element is an object that always has all three keys: - `label`: string or null - `amount`: string or null - `note`: string or null Rules: 1. Title: strip leading and trailing whitespace from `summary_title`, treating null as an empty string. If the result is non-empty, output `

TITLE

`, where TITLE is the stripped value, HTML-escaped. Otherwise output no heading. 2. Rows: process `lines` in their original order. Strip the label, treating null as an empty string. If the stripped label is empty, skip the line entirely. 3. For each line that is not skipped, output `
`. If the stripped label, lowercased, equals exactly `total`, the class attribute is instead `order-summary__row order-summary__row--total`. Inside the div, output in this order: a. `
LABEL
`, where LABEL is the stripped label, HTML-escaped. b. `
AMOUNT
`. AMOUNT is determined as follows: - If `amount` is null, AMOUNT is the literal text `Pending`. - Otherwise, if `amount` is empty after stripping (for example `""` or `" "`), AMOUNT is the literal text `Free`. - Otherwise, AMOUNT is the stripped amount, HTML-escaped. c. Only if `note` is non-null and non-empty after stripping: `
NOTE
`, where NOTE is the stripped note, HTML-escaped. Then close the div with `
`. 4. If at least one row was output, wrap all rows in `
...
`. If no rows were output, do not output the dl element at all. 5. Output order is the heading (if any), then the dl (if any). If there is neither a heading nor a dl, the output is the empty string. 6. HTML escaping must use the standard `escape` filter. Do not emit any whitespace or newlines between or around tags; the output must be one contiguous string. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/order-summary-rows.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
